name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: fd2_ prefix, input domain (lives in input.c, operates on the BIOS keyboard buffer), descriptor 'clear_keyboard_buffer' accurately reflects the body. No Ghidra address residue, no leftover hex suffix. Name matches verified behavior (drain BIOS keyboard buffer by copying HEAD to TAIL).
purpose: Drains the BIOS keyboard buffer so any pending scancodes are discarded.
logic_summary: Sets the BDA keyboard-buffer TAIL pointer (0x40:001C) equal to the HEAD pointer (0x40:001A), which empties the BIOS keyboard buffer (a circular queue). Asm: MOV ESI,0x41A; MOV AX,[ESI]; MOV [ESI+2],AX -> *(uint16*)0x41C = *(uint16*)0x41A. Single basic block, no branches, no stack frame (only PUSH/POP ESI). Called between cursor pulses, after SFX triggers, and at frame/wait boundaries to keep stale input from feeding the next wait_for_input.
